state_profile.voting_summary: Virginia offers 45 days of no-excuse early voting (41% of the 2024 vote) and no-excuse mail (10%), with mail postmarked by election day accepted for three days. Polls close at 7 p.m. Eastern; localities release early votes first, election day precincts report through the evening, and late mail plus provisionals are added over the following days. Mail ran D+47 and late-counted mail D+49 against R+6 on election day, so Virginia's margins drift steadily bluer from election night through the end of the week.
